symptoms: A cough that’s often worse in the morning
A loud heartbeat sound due to pulmonary hypertension
causes: Genetic conditions including Alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency, Ehlers-Danlos syndrome, and Marfan syndrome
treatments: Bullectomy (open surgery or video-assisted thoracic surgery)
outlook: Treatment can help you manage the condition and increase your lifespan
Bullous emphysema is a lifelong health condition
Once your lungs become damaged, they won’t heal
The sooner you start treating BE, the sooner you can help stop it from becoming worse
diagnosis: Asking about symptoms, health history, and family medical history
Blood tests (checking for acidic blood/respiratory acidosis or low oxygen levels)
Blood tests to test for alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency
living_with: Finding treatments that work for you
Talk with your healthcare provider about what vaccines you might need, including flu, COVID and pneumococcus
